restTitle: Don Q x Greenstop – House Flower Drop (Nov 8 | 2–5 PM)
seoTitle: Don Q x Greenstop House Flower Drop | Meet & Greet with A Boogie & Don Q | Greenstop NJ
description: Celebrate the Don Q x Greenstop House Flower Drop on Nov 8th in Jersey City.Shop Gorilla Pie & Guava Sherbet by Hamilton Farms at 20% OFF, enjoy raffles, giveaways, and a chance to meet A Boogie & Don Q.
dateNote: the date shown on the page is the WordPress publish date (YOOtheme post meta), not necessarily the event date
html:
Greenstop and Don Q bring you an exclusive House Flower release — Gorilla Pie and Guava Sherbet by Hamilton Farms.
Stop by November 8th from 2–5 PM for the official launch, with 20% OFF in-store, raffles, giveaways, and signed merch — plus a chance to meet A Boogie & Don Q.
